application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Erection of two houses with associated landscaping and refuse storage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( DR-A-0001 Rev. P01; DR-A-0010 Rev. P01; DR-A-0011 Rev. P01; DR-A-3001 Rev. P02; DR-A-3002 Rev. P02; DR-A-3003; DR-A-3005 Rev. P02; DR-A-3006 Rev. P02; DR-A-3601 Rev. P02;  DR-A-3603 Rev. P02; DR-A-3604 Rev. P02; DR-A-3605 Rev. P02; DR-A-3606 Rev. P02; Street elevation (received on 26 March 2020) and Energy Statement by Energy Test (received on 30 January 2020) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until the applicant has entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Energy Statement hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Classes [A-H] of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), the enlargement, improvement or other alteration of the dwellinghouse including its roof shall not be allowed without the specific granting of planning permission.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows ([other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be constructed on any elevation.

Condition : 8 - No development (except any demolition, site clearance, ground investigation and remediation work) shall take place until full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (in accordance with London Plan requirements) for the occupants of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a visibility splay of 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres shall be provided on each side of the vehicular access (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access). Thereafter, no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 metres in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected, planted or allowed to grow within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.
